name: Chat AI with Dispatcher
author: Váradi Csaba

sections.description:
Discover the Chat AI with Dispatcher plugin: a free live chat solution combining AI and human supervision for WordPress. It provides instant responses via a credit-based AI system with real-time dispatcher control.

Important: The plugin connects to an external AI service that incurs usage costs. Upon purchase, a starting credit equal to the full purchase price is credited to the user account to cover AI usage. Users can top-up credits if needed.

Why choose it?

  • Combines AI speed with human accuracy.
  • Prevents visitor frustration with real-time takeover.
  • Mobile-friendly and easy to install.

Why Choose Chat AI with Dispatcher?

  • AI + human power for perfect responses.
  • Enhances customer experience.
  • Reduces lost sales with instant support.
  • Competitive edge over basic chatbots.
  • Lightens support workload.

Key Features

  • Dispatcher Mode: Live conversation monitoring.
  • One-Click Takeover: Handle complex queries.
  • Screenshot Upload: Visual issue support.
  • Flexible Handover: Back to AI when done.
  • Multilingual: Language-independent AI.
  • Mobile-Friendly: Works on all devices.

External Services

This plugin connects to the vrcs.hu API to provide AI chatbot functionality, credit-based billing, and package management.

  • Service: vrcs.hu
  • Purpose: Provides AI-powered chatbot responses, credit management, and package selection for the plugin.
  • Data Sent:
    • During registration: Domain name, user email, store email.
    • During credit monitoring: Registration ID, domain name, credit monitoring status (0 or 1).
    • During package retrieval or registration check: Registration ID, domain name.
  • When Data is Sent:
    • When registering the plugin via the admin settings page.
    • When enabling/disabling credit monitoring.
    • When retrieving available packages or verifying registration status.
  • Terms of Service: https://www.vrcs.hu/Terms-of-Use?route=information/information&language=en-gb
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.vrcs.hu/Privacy-Policy-and-Notice?route=information/information&language=en-gb
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin in the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Register on the settings page (starting credit equal to the purchase price will be applied) to activate the chat.

Check the support documentation for issues.
sections.faq:
Q: How do I install it?

A: Upload the ZIP or install via the Plugins screen, activate, and register with a few clicks.

Q: What is it?

A: A WordPress plugin with AI chat and human dispatcher support, using a credit system.

Q: Who is it for?

A: Online stores, websites, and anyone needing simple chat support.

Q: Do I need skills?

A: No, it’s designed for non-technical users.

Q: Are there paid features?

A: Free with starting credit equal to the purchase price; top-up if needed. Future premium options possible.

1.0.3.2

  • Added real-time image preview (thumbnail) in the chat window after selecting a file and before/during upload.
  • Improved user experience (UX) for visual feedback during support interactions.

1.0.3.1

  • Fixed JS file to correctly reload uploaded images and question–answer data when the user refreshes the page.

  • (Minor adjustment to restore proper state handling after reload.)

  • Updated CSS for the footer input field to ensure consistent height and appearance across different templates.

1.0.3

This update includes the complete transition to the “chataiwd” naming convention, a Bootstrap upgrade,
and more accurate, language-aware AI query responses.

1.0.2

  • Added External Services section to readme.txt to document vrcs.hu API usage.
  • Ensured compliance with WordPress.org review requirements.

1.0.1

  • Bugfix: fixed changes requested by WP review
  • Code cleanup

1.0.0

  • Initial release with AI chat and dispatcher functionality.
